data.site_identity: simulated partitions, not independent physical institutions

splits.global_record_cohort: seeded rank modulo 5: train 0/1/2, select 3, test 4; unchanged across N

size_gates.required: all three observed buckets in every family and train/select split at each N; every intended call within its requested bucket; every site has positive and negative participation examples
size_gates.failure_policy: retain failures; revise using train and rerun audit before freeze; never silently relabel or duplicate records

next_engineering_calibration_proposal.execution_precondition: HIGGS size audit passes; workload adapter and planner/tool validation pass; transport source/provenance frozen; run plan duration fitted to measured timings
next_engineering_calibration_proposal.purpose: transport correctness, acquisition validity and runtime sizing; insufficient replicates for confirmatory energy conclusions
next_engineering_calibration_proposal.on_timeout: retain logs, mark incomplete, stop owned processes; never extend cloud window automatically

before_cloud_restart: Offline resilience tests and real HIGGS relay/replica integration pass
Current evidence copied and checksum-verified on controller and Mac Studio
Matched observer plan and finite capture runner verified without cloud
Run-specific access for Mac Studio and deadline-bound autonomous supervisor prepared
Notify user of a concrete bounded batch and predicted runtime; verify current IPs/host keys after start
Fresh host resources/clock/disk/NIC offload preflight; no competing jobs
Per-session immutable primary commit and acknowledged replica; two-host raw capture preservation
Instance stop remains user-managed unless AWS stop access is explicitly configured
scientific_pending: real measured per-physical-node paired joules, no EC2 nominal-power proxy
frozen configuration shortlist and attacker selection
held-out final acquisition after all protocol gates
second-model and any hosted-model claims backed by actual provenance

extended_mac_preparation.readiness_scope: software readiness for bounded EC2 calibration; never paper-level readiness
extended_mac_preparation.notification: local macOS LaunchAgent polls over Tailscale every 300s up to 9h; checks again on later login; no chat sender
